say:1:1910727001:1.text: What... what just happened? I just saw a horrific disaster, and scenes from the surface...
say:1:1910727001:1.source_cn: 刚才、刚才发生了什么？我看到了一场灾难，还有陆地上的景象……

say:2:1910727002:1.text: That wall of light that appeared out of thin air. It's exactly the same as the gift <style="stress"><player_name></style> used to hold back the glowing tide in Coralia!
say:2:1910727002:1.source_cn: 那道空气中突然出现的光墙，和<style=stress...
say:2:1910727002:1.male: That wall of light that appeared out of thin air. It's exactly the same as the gift <style="stress"><player_name></style> used to hold back the glowing tide in Coralia!
say:2:1910727002:1.female: That wall of light that appeared out of thin air. It's exactly the same as the gift <style="stress"><player_name></style> used to hold back the glowing tide in Coralia!

say:4:1910727004:1.text: 这是<male>他</male><female>她</female>的过去？我……不记得流光海发生过海啸。

say:5:1910727005:1.text: I've never heard of anything like this. Even in Grandma's records, there's no mention of a tidal wave capable of drowning villages on land.
say:5:1910727005:1.source_cn: 我……我没听说过，连阿嬷的记录里都没有出现过能淹没陆地...

say:6:1910727006:1.text: If it truly happened, the elders of Coralia would've made a nursery rhyme to warn the children. But no such song was ever sung.
say:6:1910727006:1.source_cn: 如果真的发生过，塔拉萨的长辈一定会编童谣来警戒小孩子，...

say:7:1910727007:1.text: Could it be even further in the past...? Or not the past at all, but the future...?
say:7:1910727007:1.source_cn: 难道是更遥远的过去吗……？或者，不是过去，是未来……？

say:8:1910727008:1.text: The future... You mean a prophecy? Those are just stories to fool the little ones. Only those who haven't lived through a renewal season believe in them.
say:8:1910727008:1.source_cn: 未来……你是说预言？那是骗幼童的，没经过洄游季的人才会信。

say:9:1910727009:1.text: 我希望看到的是预言，如果是预言，灾难就不会发生……<style="stress"><player_name></style>用的天赋，既能在之前救塔拉萨，也能在未来救陆地人。
say:9:1910727009:1.source_cn: 我希望看到的是预言，如果是预言，灾难就不会发生……<s...

say:10:1910727010:1.text: 如果有更多像<male>他</male><female>她</female>那样的人，你的族裔也会得救吧……

say:12:1910727012:1.text: I want to find out more!

say:13:1910727013:1.text: If we could learn more about this, learn how to gain that kind of gift, and learn why it can hold back a catastrophe, then maybe... maybe we could create something like that as well.
say:13:1910727013:1.source_cn: 所以，如果能知道更多——知道怎么获得那种天赋，知道它为...

say:14:1910727014:1.text: Perhaps we can save ourselves instead of waiting for others to save us.
say:14:1910727014:1.source_cn: 也许……我们可以救自己，而不是等别人拯救。

say:15:1910727015:1.text: Maybe we can also become someone like <style="stress"><player_name></style>.
say:15:1910727015:1.male: Maybe we can also become someone like <style="stress"><player_name></style>.
say:15:1910727015:1.female: Maybe we can also become someone like <style="stress"><player_name></style>.

say:16:1910727016:1.text: A gift is a gift for a reason. Don't try to be someone else.
say:16:1910727016:1.source_cn: 天赋被称作天赋自有原因……别想着成为别人。

say:17:1910727017:1.text: That being said, I do hate being saved by others.
say:17:1910727017:1.source_cn: 不过……我确实讨厌被人拯救。

say:18:1910727018:1.source_cn: 浅海裔的女儿，那些气泡还不完全……

say:19:1910727019:1.text: Well, I'll find the rest and see what happens next.
say:19:1910727019:1.source_cn: 嗯，我会把剩下的也找到，看看之后会发生什么。

say:20:1910727020:1.text: Mister Calix, can you still hold on...?
say:20:1910727020:1.source_cn: 卡律先生，你还能支撑住吗……？

say:21:1910727021:1.text: Don't ask a question like that. Just keep going.
